data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Money seized from criminals will fund nine initiatives to reduce violence, prevent reoffending, and disrupt the drug trade, says Associate Justice Minister Nicole McKee.

128390.label: Taking $14.6 million off criminals to protect New Zealanders

data.title: Regulation Ministry sets sites on building sector
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Regulation Minister David Seymour and Building and Construction Minister Simon Watts have today announced the Ministry for Regulation’s next Regulatory Review will be into the building and construction sector.

128391.label: Regulation Ministry sets sites on building sector

data.title: Resilience investment in key Waikato freight link
data.author: beehive.govt.nz

128394.label: Resilience investment in key Waikato freight link

data.title: Queenstown cable car gets lift through AIP visa
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Queenstown Cable Car project led by Southern Infrastructure Limited (SIL) has attracted $265 million in private lending through the Government’s Active Investor Plus (AIP) visa, Infrastructure Minister Chris Bishop and Immigration Minister Erica Stanford say.

128395.label: Queenstown cable car gets lift through AIP visa

data.title: Govt funds new classrooms at Wakatipu High School
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government is investing in new classrooms at Wakatipu High School to address the rapidly growing demand in Queenstown for secondary education, Education Minister Erica Stanford and Infrastructure Minister Chris Bishop say.

128396.label: Govt funds new classrooms at Wakatipu High School

data.title: Otago Central Lakes Deal signed to back growth
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government has signed a City and Regional Deal with Otago Central Lakes councils, establishing a 10-year partnership to support housing, infrastructure and economic growth in one of New Zealand’s fastest-growing regions, Infrastructure Minister Chris Bishop and Local Government Minister Simon Watts say.

128399.label: Otago Central Lakes Deal signed to back growth

data.title: Strategic plan sets direction for Queenstown transport
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: A 30-year strategic plan released today by the NZ Transport Agency (NZTA) will help focus ongoing investment in Queenstown’s transport infrastructure into the right areas, at the right time and help keep people moving, Transport Minister Chris Bishop says.

128398.label: Strategic plan sets direction for Queenstown transport
